response.answer: Top trends include mobile health apps with low-bandwidth solutions, culturally tailored content, and mixed-methods pilot designs for rural young adults' cancer prevention. Community engagement and technology integration are key. Recent studies emphasize real-time evaluations and remote monitoring.
